summary: The Verge's Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2023 roundup collects tech and gadget deals priced under $25, as a companion to its $50 and $100 budget lists. It covers phone accessories and trackers, smart home gear, streaming devices and subscriptions, games and storage, and staff favorites. Each item lists the sale price, original price and retailer.
one_line: The Verge's 2023 Black Friday and Cyber Monday roundup of useful tech and gadget deals costing under $25, from AirTags to streaming subscriptions.
key_facts: Apple AirTag is $24 (down from $29, 17% off) at Amazon, or $80 for a four-pack; it uses ultra wideband technology.
Anker 511 Charger (30W) is $16, down from $23 (30% off), at Amazon.
Tile Pro is $25 (down from $35) and is the company's loudest Bluetooth tracker, with a 400-foot range and a user-replaceable battery.
Tile Slim (2022 version) is $20, down from $35 (43% off), has a 250-foot range, and works with both Android and iOS.
Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K (2023) is $25, down from $50 (50% off), with Wi-Fi 6, Dolby Atmos / Vision, HDR10 Plus and a 1.7GHz processor.
Max's ad-supported plan is $2.99 a month for six months ($18 total) instead of $9.99 a month, until November 27th.
Ad-supported Hulu for a year is $11.88 (99 cents a month), saving $68 off the $79.99 annual plan, until November 28th at 11:59PM PT.
Mass Effect Legendary Edition is $12 (down from $60, 80% off) at Amazon as a Steam code.
Samsung Evo Select 512GB microSD card is $25, down from $35, for Nintendo Switch, Steam Deck or Asus ROG Ally.
Uni's 10-foot USB-C to USB-C cable is $7.99 ($12 off) and can deliver 100 watts, enough for a 16-inch MacBook Pro.
Roku Express 4K Plus is $24.97, down from $39.99.
Govee 100ft Smart LED Strip Lights are $15 (40% off) with 64 preset scenes.
Verge merch store has 30 percent off shirt designs and 40 percent off mugs for Black Friday / Cyber Monday.
